discrepancies.observed: The pull-request workflow resolved provenance against the candidate head while actions/checkout used the GitHub-generated merge ref by default.
discrepancies.repair: Check out the exact admitted head and fail closed unless git HEAD equals the resolved admission head.
discrepancies.risk: Tests and receipts could describe different source identities.

discrepancies.observed: Phoenix source_sha preferred GITHUB_SHA over the checked-out Git HEAD.
discrepancies.repair: Use validated git HEAD first; accept validated GITHUB_SHA only when no Git checkout exists.
discrepancies.risk: A head-built archive could be labelled with the synthetic pull-request merge-ref SHA.

discrepancies.observed: The integration suite expected service-local deployment workflows and RELEASE_MANIFEST.sha256 inside the standalone Phoenix Core export.
discrepancies.repair: Keep full manifest verification in source mode and verify explicit exclusion reasons in Core-export mode.
discrepancies.risk: A source-repository invariant contradicted the deliberate zero-workflow Core projection.
